breakdown.description: The prompt uses the no-drop suddenly applied-load result P_max = 2W even though the problem includes a nonzero drop height, which changes the energy balance and the maximum force.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to solve the energy conservation equation W(h + δ_max) = (P_max² L)/(2AE) directly for P_max, incorporating the nonzero drop height h = 150 mm. It does not apply the shortcut P_max = 2W (the suddenly applied-load result), which was the erroneous instruction in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth approach of solving the full energy balance equation.
